grade3_math_proficient.label: Third graders proficient in math (proficient or above on the state math test)
grade3_math_proficient.source: Ohio Department of Education and Workforce, school report card data; NCES Common Core of Data for weights
grade3_math_proficient.note: Share of tested third graders who scored proficient or above on Ohio's third grade math test. County figures combine public school districts and in-person community schools, weighted by grade 3 enrollment; schools too small for ODEW to report are left out. Fewer students tested in 2020-2021. The Ohio figure is built the same way from all districts and schools so counties compare on equal terms; ODEW's published state figure is 62.1% for 2025-2026.

chronic_absent_rate.label: Students chronically absent (missed 10% or more of school)
chronic_absent_rate.source: Ohio Department of Education and Workforce, school report card data; NCES Common Core of Data for weights
chronic_absent_rate.vintage: school years 2017-2018, 2018-2019 and 2025-2026 only (2019-2020 through 2024-2025 not on disk); ODEW files created 2019-10 and 2026-09; pulled 2026-11-16
chronic_absent_rate.note: Share of students who missed 10% or more of the school year, for any reason, excused or not. County figures cover traditional public school districts only, weighted by enrollment; community schools are left out. The Ohio figure is built the same way from all districts; ODEW's own state figure covers all public schools and is not in the files used here.

fields.grade3_enrollment_ccd: CCD fall grade 3 membership (the county weight; ODEW does not publish a tested count)
fields.chronic_absent_rate: percent chronically absent, all students, ODEW
fields.enrollment_odew: ODEW enrollment, all students, same file (the county weight for this year)
fields.*_flag: ODEW code when the value is not a number (NC, <10, NA), else null
